svg.text: Mass: dumbbell 0.9-1.4 kg + boards and cables about 80 g, matching the product target. Flat hex faces: tape holds, it does not roll, Z is the same every time.

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. The 4517 must not move: foam tape plus a turn of tape over it. A loose sensor teaches the model its own rattle.

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Photograph the mounting as ml/figures/mounting-v1.jpg, write it into ml/data-protocol.md section 3, then never change it. The enclosure mounts the 4517 the same way so the data stays valid.

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Only the Nano on the breadboard; the four 4209 leads go into the holes beside its pins: 3V3, GND, A4, A5. No OLED, no pulse sensor.

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Before recording: 5 s at rest shows az about +9.8 and gx gy gz about 0 (Z up); two curls show gx far above gy and gz (X along the grip).
